items.title: Energy Transition Today - LevelTen Energy Ventures Into Asia-Pacific Clean Energy Market
items.summary: LevelTen Energy has announced its expansion into the Asia-Pacific region, marking a significant development in the global energy transition. This move extends LevelTen's clean energy marketplace, which supports corporate buyers in North America and Europe, into a region that consumes half of the world's electricity. items.title: GE Vernova Is 35% Below Its High After Raising Its Year-End Gas Turbine Goal to 130 Gigawatts
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova stock is 35% below its high, even though the company raised its year-end gas turbine goal to at least 130 gigawatts from at least 125. Analysts kept raising earnings estimates through the selloff, so the market is pricing in a peak in turbine demand that the contracts don’t show yet.
